chats.answer:
If you're looking for a 3D printer with a built-in or interchangeable laser engraver, there are several hybrid machines that can do both.

These machines typically combine:

FDM 3D printing — making plastic objects from filament.

Laser engraving — engraving wood, leather, cardboard, and certain other materials.

Laser cutting — cutting thin materials, depending on laser power.

The main advantage is having both capabilities in one machine rather than buying two separate devices.
